def extract_text_from_pdf(file_path):
    from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text
    try:
        return extract_text(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"PDF extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path):
    images = convert_from_path(file_path)
    text = ""
    for image in images:
        text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    return text

# === Text Extractors for Other Formats ===
def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    try:
        doc = docx.Document(file_path)
        return "\\n".join([para.text for para in doc.paragraphs])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DOCX extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_excel(file_path):
    try:
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
        text = ""
        for sheet in wb.worksheets:
            for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                row_text = " ".join([str(cell) for cell in row if cell is not None])
                text += row_text + "\\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Excel extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_eml(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return msg.get_body(preferencelist=('plain')).get_content()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"EML extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_zip(zip_path):
    try:
        text = ""
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            zip_ref.extractall("temp_zip")
            for name in zip_ref.namelist():
                path = os.path.join("temp_zip", name)
                text += extract_text_from_file(path) + "\\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ZIP extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

# === Master Extraction Dispatcher ===
def extract_text_from_file(file_path):
    path = file_path.lower()
    if path.endswith(".pdf"):
        return extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path) if is_scanned(file_path) else extract_text_from_pdf(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".docx"):
        return extract_text_from_docx(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".xlsx"):
        return extract_text_from_excel(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".eml"):
        return extract_text_from_eml(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".zip"):
        return extract_text_from_zip(file_path)
    else:
        return ""

# Manually regenerate Part C with field extraction + GOLD LOCK 200+ logic
block1_partC_manual = '''
# === FIELD EXTRACTION (GOLD LOCK 200+) ===

def extract_name(text):
    doc = nlp(text)
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            tokens = ent.text.strip().split()
            if 1 < len(tokens) <= 4:
                return tokens[0].capitalize(), tokens[-1].capitalize()
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_phone(text):
    match = re.search(r"(\\+?1[-\\.\\s]?)?(\\(?\\d{3}\\)?[-\\.\\s]?\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{4})", text)
    return match.group(2).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_gpa(text):
    match = re.search(r"GPA\\s*[:=]?\\s*(\\d\\.\\d{1,2})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    return match.group(1) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",
        "m.a.": "MA", "mba": "MBA", "associate": "AS"
    }
    for key in degree_map:
        if key in text.lower():
            return degree_map[key]
    return "Unknown"

def extract_major(text):
    major_keywords = [
        "Civil Engineering", "Environmental Engineering", "Construction Engineering",
        "Chemical Engineering", "Mechanical Engineering", "Computer Science",
        "Architecture", "Industrial Engineering"
    ]
    for major in major_keywords:
        if major.lower() in text.lower():
            return major
    return "Unknown"

def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December|January|February|March|April)\\s+\\d{4}", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_geographic_alignment(text):
    locations = []
    pattern = re.findall(r"\\b([A-Z][a-z]+,?\\s?[A-Z]{2})\\b", text)
    for loc in pattern:
        clean = loc.strip().replace(",", "")
        if clean not in locations:
            locations.append(clean)
        if len(locations) >= 4:
            break
    return locations

def extract_fields(text, filename="Unknown"):
    first_name, last_name = extract_name(text)
    email = extract_email(text)
    phone = extract_phone(text)
    gpa = extract_gpa(text)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    major = extract_major(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)
    alignment = extract_geographic_alignment(text)

    return {
        "Raw Text": text.strip(),
        "First Name": first_name,
        "Last Name": last_name,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major,
        "Latest University": "Unknown",
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "GPA": gpa,
        "Email": email,
        "Phone Number": phone,
        "Geographic Alignment": alignment,
        "Source File": os.path.basename(filename)
    }
'''

# === SMART SPLITTER & MET ON CAMPUS DETECTION (Locks 162, 181–183) ===

def detect_met_on_campus(text, filename):
    found_score = None
    met_flag = False

    # Check for handwritten score in OCR (1–3 or 2.5, 3+)
    score_match = re.search(r"(?:^|\s)([1-3](?:\\.5|\+)?)(?:\\s|$)", text)
    if score_match:
        try:
            found_score = float(score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    # Filename logic: e.g., 2-Michigan.pdf or 3+_resume.pdf
    fname_score_match = re.search(r"\\b([1-3](?:\\.5|\\+)?)[-_]", filename)
    if fname_score_match and not found_score:
        try:
            found_score = float(fname_score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    return ("Yes" if met_flag else "No/Unsure", str(found_score) if found_score else "Unknown")

def cluster_resume_start(text_lines):
    cues = {
        "email": any(re.search(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "phone": any(re.search(r"\\d{3}[\\s\\-\\)]?\\d{3}[\\s\\-]?\\d{4}", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "name": any(len(line.split()) in [2, 3] and line.isupper() for line in text_lines[:5]),
        "education": any("education" in line.lower() for line in text_lines[:12])
    }
    cue_count = sum(cues.values())
    return cue_count >= 2

def process_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    lines = text.strip().split("\\n")
    cues = cluster_resume_start(lines)
    fields = extract_fields(text, file_path)
    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)

    fields["Met on Campus"] = met_flag
    fields["Representative Score"] = rep_score
    fields["Split Cue Cluster"] = "Yes" if cues else "No"

    # Apply known good override if present
    filename_key = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if filename_key in known_good_fields:
        for k, v in known_good_fields[filename_key].items():
            fields[k] = v

    return fields

✅ Block 2, Part A (Lines 451–600) — Smart Splitter & Met on Campus Detection

# === SMART SPLITTER & MET ON CAMPUS DETECTION (Locks 162, 181–183) ===

def detect_met_on_campus(text, filename):
    found_score = None
    met_flag = False

    # Check for handwritten score in OCR (1–3 or 2.5, 3+)
    score_match = re.search(r"(?:^|\s)([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)(?:\s|$)", text)
    if score_match:
        try:
            found_score = float(score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    # Filename logic: e.g., 2-Michigan.pdf or 3+_resume.pdf
    fname_score_match = re.search(r"\b([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)[-_]", filename)
    if fname_score_match and not found_score:
        try:
            found_score = float(fname_score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    return ("Yes" if met_flag else "No/Unsure", str(found_score) if found_score else "Unknown")

def cluster_resume_start(text_lines):
    cues = {
        "email": any(re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "phone": any(re.search(r"\d{3}[\s\-\)]?\d{3}[\s\-]?\d{4}", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "name": any(len(line.split()) in [2, 3] and line.isupper() for line in text_lines[:5]),
        "education": any("education" in line.lower() for line in text_lines[:12])
    }
    cue_count = sum(cues.values())
    return cue_count >= 2

def process_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    lines = text.strip().split("\n")
    cues = cluster_resume_start(lines)
    fields = extract_fields(text, file_path)
    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)

    fields["Met on Campus"] = met_flag
    fields["Representative Score"] = rep_score
    fields["Split Cue Cluster"] = "Yes" if cues else "No"

    # Apply known good override if present
    filename_key = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if filename_key in known_good_fields:
        for k, v in known_good_fields[filename_key].items():
            fields[k] = v

    return fields

# Begin Block 2, Part B (Lines 601–750): JSON writer, validator, and file mover

# === SAVE TO JSON + VALIDATION ===

def validate_fields(data):
    if not re.match(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", data.get("Email", "")):
        print("[WARNING] Invalid email format.")
    if not re.match(r"\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{4}", data.get("Phone Number", "")):
        print("[WARNING] Phone number may be malformed.")
    if data.get("Latest Degree") == "Unknown":
        print("[WARNING] Degree not detected.")
    if data.get("Latest University") == "Unknown":
        print("[WARNING] University not detected.")

def save_to_json(data, output_dir):
    if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
        os.makedirs(output_dir)
    last = data.get("Last Name", "Unknown")
    first = data.get("First Name", "Unknown")
    degree = data.get("Latest Degree", "Unknown")
    major = data.get("Latest Major", "Unknown")
    school = data.get("Latest University", "Unknown").replace(",", "")
    grad = data.get("Graduation Date", "Unknown")
    filename = f"{last}, {first} - {degree} - {major} - {school} ({grad}).json"
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\s\\(\\)\\.]", "", filename)
    full_path = os.path.join(output_dir, safe_name)

    with open(full_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=4)
    print(f"[✔] Saved: {full_path}")

def move_to_processed(file_path):
    try:
        base = os.path.basename(file_path)
        shutil.move(file_path, os.path.join(processed_directory, base))
        print(f"[Moved] {base} to Processed folder.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] Moving file failed: {e}")

# === WATCHDOG HANDLER ===

class ResumeHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_created(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        print(f"[🔍] Detected file: {event.src_path}")
        parsed = process_resume(event.src_path)
        validate_fields(parsed)
        save_to_json(parsed, save_directory)
        move_to_processed(event.src_path)

def start_watching():
    observer = Observer()
    handler = ResumeHandler()
    observer.schedule(handler, monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print(f"[👀] Watching for new resumes in: {monitor_directory}")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

# Begin Block 2, Part C (Lines 751–900): LLM Repair Layer and Heuristic Rewriter
block2_partC = '''
# === LLM REPAIR LAYER (GOLD LOCK 160-161) ===

def repair_with_llm(text, extracted_fields):
    try:
        prompt = f"""
You are a resume parser. The following raw resume text was extracted via OCR or PDF. The current extracted fields are incomplete or missing.
Your job is to correct or complete the fields using only the raw resume text below.

Raw Resume:
{text}

Current Parsed Fields:
{json.dumps(extracted_fields, indent=2)}

Respond ONLY with corrected JSON:
"""
        response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
            model="gpt-4",
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert resume parser."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=1000,
            temperature=0.3
        )
        corrected = json.loads(response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
        print("[🔁] LLM Repair Applied")
        return corrected
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[LLM ERROR] {e}")
        return extracted_fields

# === INTEGRATED EXECUTION WRAPPER ===

def process_and_repair(file_path):
    print(f"[📄] Processing: {file_path}")
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    lines = text.strip().split("\\n")
    split_cues = cluster_resume_start(lines)
    base_fields = extract_fields(text, file_path)

    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)
    base_fields["Met on Campus"] = met_flag
    base_fields["Representative Score"] = rep_score
    base_fields["Split Cue Cluster"] = "Yes" if split_cues else "No"

    if os.path.basename(file_path) in known_good_fields:
        print("[✅] Overriding with known good fields")
        base_fields.update(known_good_fields[os.path.basename(file_path)])

    if any(val == "Unknown" for key, val in base_fields.items() if key not in ["Representative Score", "Split Cue Cluster"]):
        base_fields = repair_with_llm(text, base_fields)

    return base_fields

# Begin Block 3, Part B (Lines 1051–1200): Legacy support, post-parse heuristics, cleanup utilities
block3_partB = '''
# === LEGACY SUPPORT HOOKS + BACKWARDS COMPATIBLE UTILITIES ===

def normalize_caps(value):
    # Normalize ALL CAPS names to capitalized
    if value and value.isupper() and len(value.split()) <= 3:
        return " ".join([word.capitalize() for word in value.split()])
    return value

def enforce_field_normalization(fields):
    fields["First Name"] = normalize_caps(fields.get("First Name", ""))
    fields["Last Name"] = normalize_caps(fields.get("Last Name", ""))

    if fields.get("Latest University", "").lower() in university_normalization:
        fields["Latest University"] = university_normalization[fields["Latest University"]]

    return fields

def drop_duplicates_from_alignment(alignments):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for loc in alignments:
        clean = loc.strip()
        if clean not in seen:
            result.append(clean)
            seen.add(clean)
    return result[:4]  # max 4 locations

def sanitize_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\u2022", "-").replace("\\xa0", " ").replace("\\n\\n", "\\n").strip()

def strip_non_utf8(text):
    return text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore").decode()

# === TEMP CLEANUP LOGIC ===

def cleanup_temp_folder():
    if os.path.exists("temp_zip"):
        shutil.rmtree("temp_zip", ignore_errors=True)
    print("[🧹] Temp folder cleaned")

# === SAFE FINALIZER ===

def finalize_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    text = strip_non_utf8(sanitize_text(text))
    result = extract_fields(text, file_path)
    result["Raw Text"] = text
    result = enforce_field_normalization(result)
    result["Geographic Alignment"] = drop_duplicates_from_alignment(result.get("Geographic Alignment", []))
    validate_fields(result)
    save_to_json(result, save_directory)
    move_to_processed(file_path)
    cleanup_temp_folder()

# === OCR Logic ===
def is_scanned(file_path):
    try:
        doc = fitz.open(file_path)
        for page in doc:
            if page.get_images():
                return True
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Scan check failed: {e}")
        return False

def extract_text_from_pdf(file_path):
    from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text
    try:
        return extract_text(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"PDF extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path):
    images = convert_from_path(file_path)
    text = ""
    for image in images:
        text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    return text

# === Text Extractors for Other Formats ===
def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    try:
        doc = docx.Document(file_path)
        return "\\n".join([para.text for para in doc.paragraphs])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DOCX extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_excel(file_path):
    try:
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
        text = ""
        for sheet in wb.worksheets:
            for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                row_text = " ".join([str(cell) for cell in row if cell is not None])
                text += row_text + "\\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Excel extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_eml(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return msg.get_body(preferencelist=('plain')).get_content()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"EML extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_zip(zip_path):
    try:
        text = ""
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            zip_ref.extractall("temp_zip")
            for name in zip_ref.namelist():
                path = os.path.join("temp_zip", name)
                text += extract_text_from_file(path) + "\\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ZIP extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

# === Master Extraction Dispatcher ===
def extract_text_from_file(file_path):
    path = file_path.lower()
    if path.endswith(".pdf"):
        return extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path) if is_scanned(file_path) else extract_text_from_pdf(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".docx"):
        return extract_text_from_docx(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".xlsx"):
        return extract_text_from_excel(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".eml"):
        return extract_text_from_eml(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".zip"):
        return extract_text_from_zip(file_path)
    else:
        return ""
'''

# Manually regenerate Part C with field extraction + GOLD LOCK 200+ logic
block1_partC_manual = '''
# === FIELD EXTRACTION (GOLD LOCK 200+) ===

def extract_name(text):
    doc = nlp(text)
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            tokens = ent.text.strip().split()
            if 1 < len(tokens) <= 4:
                return tokens[0].capitalize(), tokens[-1].capitalize()
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_phone(text):
    match = re.search(r"(\\+?1[-\\.\\s]?)?(\\(?\\d{3}\\)?[-\\.\\s]?\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{4})", text)
    return match.group(2).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_gpa(text):
    match = re.search(r"GPA\\s*[:=]?\\s*(\\d\\.\\d{1,2})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    return match.group(1) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",
        "m.a.": "MA", "mba": "MBA", "associate": "AS"
    }
    for key in degree_map:
        if key in text.lower():
            return degree_map[key]
    return "Unknown"

def extract_major(text):
    major_keywords = [
        "Civil Engineering", "Environmental Engineering", "Construction Engineering",
        "Chemical Engineering", "Mechanical Engineering", "Computer Science",
        "Architecture", "Industrial Engineering"
    ]
    for major in major_keywords:
        if major.lower() in text.lower():
            return major
    return "Unknown"

def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December|January|February|March|April)\\s+\\d{4}", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_geographic_alignment(text):
    locations = []
    pattern = re.findall(r"\\b([A-Z][a-z]+,?\\s?[A-Z]{2})\\b", text)
    for loc in pattern:
        clean = loc.strip().replace(",", "")
        if clean not in locations:
            locations.append(clean)
        if len(locations) >= 4:
            break
    return locations

def extract_fields(text, filename="Unknown"):
    first_name, last_name = extract_name(text)
    email = extract_email(text)
    phone = extract_phone(text)
    gpa = extract_gpa(text)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    major = extract_major(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)
    alignment = extract_geographic_alignment(text)

    return {
        "Raw Text": text.strip(),
        "First Name": first_name,
        "Last Name": last_name,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major,
        "Latest University": "Unknown",
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "GPA": gpa,
        "Email": email,
        "Phone Number": phone,
        "Geographic Alignment": alignment,
        "Source File": os.path.basename(filename)
    }
'''

# Begin Block 2, Part A (Lines 451–600): Smart splitter, campus detection, and met on campus logic
block2_partA = '''
# === SMART SPLITTER & MET ON CAMPUS DETECTION (Locks 162, 181–183) ===

def detect_met_on_campus(text, filename):
    found_score = None
    met_flag = False

    # Check for handwritten score in OCR (1–3 or 2.5, 3+)
    score_match = re.search(r"(?:^|\s)([1-3](?:\\.5|\+)?)(?:\\s|$)", text)
    if score_match:
        try:
            found_score = float(score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    # Filename logic: e.g., 2-Michigan.pdf or 3+_resume.pdf
    fname_score_match = re.search(r"\\b([1-3](?:\\.5|\\+)?)[-_]", filename)
    if fname_score_match and not found_score:
        try:
            found_score = float(fname_score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    return ("Yes" if met_flag else "No/Unsure", str(found_score) if found_score else "Unknown")

def cluster_resume_start(text_lines):
    cues = {
        "email": any(re.search(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "phone": any(re.search(r"\\d{3}[\\s\\-\\)]?\\d{3}[\\s\\-]?\\d{4}", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "name": any(len(line.split()) in [2, 3] and line.isupper() for line in text_lines[:5]),
        "education": any("education" in line.lower() for line in text_lines[:12])
    }
    cue_count = sum(cues.values())
    return cue_count >= 2

def process_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    lines = text.strip().split("\\n")
    cues = cluster_resume_start(lines)
    fields = extract_fields(text, file_path)
    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)

    fields["Met on Campus"] = met_flag
    fields["Representative Score"] = rep_score
    fields["Split Cue Cluster"] = "Yes" if cues else "No"

    # Apply known good override if present
    filename_key = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if filename_key in known_good_fields:
        for k, v in known_good_fields[filename_key].items():
            fields[k] = v

    return fields
'''

# Begin Block 2, Part B (Lines 601–750): JSON writer, validator, and file mover
block2_partB = '''
# === SAVE TO JSON + VALIDATION ===

def validate_fields(data):
    if not re.match(r"[\\w\\.-]+@[\\w\\.-]+", data.get("Email", "")):
        print("[WARNING] Invalid email format.")
    if not re.match(r"\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{3}[-\\.\\s]?\\d{4}", data.get("Phone Number", "")):
        print("[WARNING] Phone number may be malformed.")
    if data.get("Latest Degree") == "Unknown":
        print("[WARNING] Degree not detected.")
    if data.get("Latest University") == "Unknown":
        print("[WARNING] University not detected.")

def save_to_json(data, output_dir):
    if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
        os.makedirs(output_dir)
    last = data.get("Last Name", "Unknown")
    first = data.get("First Name", "Unknown")
    degree = data.get("Latest Degree", "Unknown")
    major = data.get("Latest Major", "Unknown")
    school = data.get("Latest University", "Unknown").replace(",", "")
    grad = data.get("Graduation Date", "Unknown")
    filename = f"{last}, {first} - {degree} - {major} - {school} ({grad}).json"
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9\\-\\s\\(\\)\\.]", "", filename)
    full_path = os.path.join(output_dir, safe_name)

    with open(full_path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=4)
    print(f"[✔] Saved: {full_path}")

def move_to_processed(file_path):
    try:
        base = os.path.basename(file_path)
        shutil.move(file_path, os.path.join(processed_directory, base))
        print(f"[Moved] {base} to Processed folder.")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[ERROR] Moving file failed: {e}")

# === WATCHDOG HANDLER ===

class ResumeHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_created(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        print(f"[🔍] Detected file: {event.src_path}")
        parsed = process_resume(event.src_path)
        validate_fields(parsed)
        save_to_json(parsed, save_directory)
        move_to_processed(event.src_path)

def start_watching():
    observer = Observer()
    handler = ResumeHandler()
    observer.schedule(handler, monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print(f"[👀] Watching for new resumes in: {monitor_directory}")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

# === LLM REPAIR LAYER (GOLD LOCK 160-161) ===

def repair_with_llm(text, extracted_fields):
    try:
        prompt = f"""
You are a resume parser. The following raw resume text was extracted via OCR or PDF. The current extracted fields are incomplete or missing.
Your job is to correct or complete the fields using only the raw resume text below.

Raw Resume:
{text}

Current Parsed Fields:
{json.dumps(extracted_fields, indent=2)}

Respond ONLY with corrected JSON:
"""
        response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
            model="gpt-4",
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are an expert resume parser."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=1000,
            temperature=0.3
        )
        corrected = json.loads(response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
        print("[🔁] LLM Repair Applied")
        return corrected
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[LLM ERROR] {e}")
        return extracted_fields

# === INTEGRATED EXECUTION WRAPPER ===

def process_and_repair(file_path):
    print(f"[📄] Processing: {file_path}")
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    lines = text.strip().split("\\n")
    split_cues = cluster_resume_start(lines)
    base_fields = extract_fields(text, file_path)

    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)
    base_fields["Met on Campus"] = met_flag
    base_fields["Representative Score"] = rep_score
    base_fields["Split Cue Cluster"] = "Yes" if split_cues else "No"

    if os.path.basename(file_path) in known_good_fields:
        print("[✅] Overriding with known good fields")
        base_fields.update(known_good_fields[os.path.basename(file_path)])

    if any(val == "Unknown" for key, val in base_fields.items() if key not in ["Representative Score", "Split Cue Cluster"]):
        base_fields = repair_with_llm(text, base_fields)

    return base_fields

# === LEGACY SUPPORT HOOKS + BACKWARDS COMPATIBLE UTILITIES ===

def normalize_caps(value):
    # Normalize ALL CAPS names to capitalized
    if value and value.isupper() and len(value.split()) <= 3:
        return " ".join([word.capitalize() for word in value.split()])
    return value

def enforce_field_normalization(fields):
    fields["First Name"] = normalize_caps(fields.get("First Name", ""))
    fields["Last Name"] = normalize_caps(fields.get("Last Name", ""))

    if fields.get("Latest University", "").lower() in university_normalization:
        fields["Latest University"] = university_normalization[fields["Latest University"]]

    return fields

def drop_duplicates_from_alignment(alignments):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for loc in alignments:
        clean = loc.strip()
        if clean not in seen:
            result.append(clean)
            seen.add(clean)
    return result[:4]  # max 4 locations

def sanitize_text(text):
    return text.replace("\\u2022", "-").replace("\\xa0", " ").replace("\\n\\n", "\\n").strip()

def strip_non_utf8(text):
    return text.encode("utf-8", errors="ignore").decode()

# === TEMP CLEANUP LOGIC ===

def cleanup_temp_folder():
    if os.path.exists("temp_zip"):
        shutil.rmtree("temp_zip", ignore_errors=True)
    print("[🧹] Temp folder cleaned")

# === SAFE FINALIZER ===

def finalize_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    text = strip_non_utf8(sanitize_text(text))
    result = extract_fields(text, file_path)
    result["Raw Text"] = text
    result = enforce_field_normalization(result)
    result["Geographic Alignment"] = drop_duplicates_from_alignment(result.get("Geographic Alignment", []))
    validate_fields(result)
    save_to_json(result, save_directory)
    move_to_processed(file_path)
    cleanup_temp_folder()
'''

# === KNOWN GOOD PATCHER & LOCAL MEMORY (Lock 141) ===

def apply_known_override(fields, source_filename):

        print("[⚠] Applying override from known_good_fields.json")

# LOCK 1 - ENSURE NAME IS DETECTED USING NLP
# LOCK 2 - LIMIT TO 2–4 WORDS
# LOCK 3 - CAPITALIZE IF ALL CAPS

def extract_name(text):
    doc = nlp(text)
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            tokens = ent.text.strip().split()
            if 1 < len(tokens) <= 4:
                return tokens[0].capitalize(), tokens[-1].capitalize()
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"
✅ LOCK 11–20: Email and Phone Format Validation
# LOCK 11 - MATCH STANDARD EMAIL FORMAT
# LOCK 12 - STRIP LEADING/TRAILING WHITESPACE
# LOCK 13 - EMAIL REQUIRED TO BE NON-EMPTY IF PRESENT

def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0).strip() if match else "Unknown"

# LOCK 14 - VALID PHONE NUMBER FORMAT (10 DIGITS, US-STYLE)
# LOCK 15 - SUPPORT (XXX) XXX-XXXX OR XXX.XXX.XXXX
# LOCK 16 - REMOVE WHITESPACE AND EXTRANEOUS SYMBOLS

def extract_phone(text):
    match = re.search(r"(\+?1[\s\-\.]?)?(\(?\d{3}\)?[\s\-\.]?\d{3}[\s\-\.]?\d{4})", text)
    return match.group(2).strip() if match else "Unknown"
✅ LOCK 21–30: GPA Format, Required for Engineering
# LOCK 21 - GPA MUST BE 0.00–4.00 FORMAT
# LOCK 22 - SUPPORT “GPA:” OR “GPA =” OR “GPA -”
# LOCK 23 - ONLY GRAB FIRST GPA ON PAGE

def extract_gpa(text):
    match = re.search(r"GPA\s*[:=\-]?\s*(\d\.\d{1,2})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    return match.group(1) if match else "Unknown"

def is_scanned(file_path):

                return True
        return False

# LOCK 40 - SUPPORT .DOCX AND CONVERT TEXT
def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    try:
        doc = docx.Document(file_path)
        return "\n".join([para.text for para in doc.paragraphs])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DOCX extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

# LOCK 41 - SUPPORT .XLSX AND FLATTEN TEXT
def extract_text_from_excel(file_path):
    try:
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
        text = ""
        for sheet in wb.worksheets:
            for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                row_text = " ".join([str(cell) for cell in row if cell])
                text += row_text + "\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Excel extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

# LOCK 42 - SUPPORT .EML (EMAIL) FORMATS
def extract_text_from_eml(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, "rb") as f:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return msg.get_body(preferencelist=('plain')).get_content()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"EML extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

# LOCK 43 - UNZIP .ZIP FILES, EXTRACT ALL TEXT
def extract_text_from_zip(zip_path):
    try:
        text = ""
        with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            zip_ref.extractall("temp_zip")
            for name in zip_ref.namelist():
                path = os.path.join("temp_zip", name)
                text += extract_text_from_file(path) + "\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ZIP extract failed: {e}")
        return ""
✅ LOCKS 50–59: Campus Detection, Score Override, Alignment
# LOCK 50 - MET ON CAMPUS = TRUE IF HANDWRITTEN SCORE OR FILE CONTAINS 1–3+
# LOCK 51 - EXTRACT 2.5, 3+ OR VARIANTS FROM HANDWRITING

def detect_met_on_campus(text, filename):
    found_score = None
    met_flag = False

    score_match = re.search(r"(?:^|\s)([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)(?:\s|$)", text)
    if score_match:
        try:
            found_score = float(score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    fname_score_match = re.search(r"\b([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)[-_]", filename)
    if fname_score_match and not found_score:
        try:
            found_score = float(fname_score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    return ("Yes" if met_flag else "No/Unsure", str(found_score) if found_score else "Unknown")
✅ LOCKS 60–69: Geographical Alignment Extraction
# LOCK 60 - UP TO 4 UNIQUE CITY, STATE COMBOS
# LOCK 61 - DEDUPLICATE EXACT MATCHES

def extract_geographic_alignment(text):
    locations = []
    pattern = re.findall(r"\b([A-Z][a-z]+,?\s?[A-Z]{2})\b", text)
    for loc in pattern:
        clean = loc.strip().replace(",", "")
        if clean not in locations:
            locations.append(clean)
        if len(locations) >= 4:
            break
    return locations

# LOCK 80 - RESUME SPLIT TRIGGER: EMAIL, PHONE, NAME, EDUCATION BLOCK
# LOCK 81 - CLUSTERING = 2 OF 4 CUES WITHIN 8 LINES
# LOCK 82 - NAME DETECTION IN TOP 1/3 OF PAGE IF BOLD/UPPERCASE

def cluster_resume_start(text_lines):
    cues = {
        "email": any(re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "phone": any(re.search(r"\d{3}[\s\-)]?\d{3}[\s\-]?\d{4}", line) for line in text_lines[:10]),
        "name": any(len(line.split()) in [2, 3] and line.isupper() for line in text_lines[:5]),
        "education": any("education" in line.lower() for line in text_lines[:12])
    }
    cue_count = sum(cues.values())
    return cue_count >= 2

# LOCK 90 - STRIP DOUBLE NEWLINES IN TEXT

def sanitize_text(text):

# LOCK 92 - UTF-8 ENFORCED

def strip_non_utf8(text):

# LOCK 100 - DEDUPLICATE GEOGRAPHIC ALIGNMENTS
# LOCK 101 - VALIDATE SPLIT TRIGGER WITH CAMPUS DETECTION

def drop_duplicates_from_alignment(alignments):
    seen = set()
    result = []
    for loc in alignments:
        clean = loc.strip()
        if clean not in seen:
            result.append(clean)
            seen.add(clean)
    return result[:4]

# === OCR + TEXT EXTRACTION FUNCTIONS ===

def is_scanned(file_path):
    """Determine if the PDF is image-based (scanned) or contains selectable text."""
    try:
        doc = fitz.open(file_path)
        for page in doc:
            if page.get_images():
                return True
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] Scan check failed: {e}")
        return False

def extract_text_from_pdf(file_path):
    """Extract text from digital PDF."""
    from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text
    try:
        return extract_text(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] PDF text extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path):
    """OCR for scanned PDFs."""
    images = convert_from_path(file_path)
    text = ""
    for image in images:
        text += pytesseract.image_to_string(image)
    return text

def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    try:
        doc = docx.Document(file_path)
        return "\n".join([para.text for para in doc.paragraphs])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] DOCX extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_excel(file_path):
    try:
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
        text = ""
        for sheet in wb.worksheets:
            for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True):
                text += " ".join([str(cell) for cell in row if cell is not None]) + "\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] Excel extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_eml(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return msg.get_body(preferencelist=('plain')).get_content()
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] EML extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_zip(file_path):
    try:
        text = ""
        with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            zip_ref.extractall("temp_zip")
            for name in zip_ref.namelist():
                path = os.path.join("temp_zip", name)
                text += extract_text_from_file(path) + "\n"
        return text
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[Error] ZIP extract failed: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_file(file_path):
    path = file_path.lower()
    if path.endswith(".pdf"):
        return extract_text_from_image_pdf(file_path) if is_scanned(file_path) else extract_text_from_pdf(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".docx"):
        return extract_text_from_docx(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".xlsx"):
        return extract_text_from_excel(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".eml"):
        return extract_text_from_eml(file_path)
    elif path.endswith(".zip"):
        return extract_text_from_zip(file_path)
    else:
        return ""

# === FIELD EXTRACTION LOGIC (Locks 200–204) ===

def normalize_caps(value):
    if value and value.isupper() and len(value.split()) <= 3:
        return " ".join([w.capitalize() for w in value.split()])
    return value

def extract_name(text):
    doc = nlp(text)
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            tokens = ent.text.strip().split()
            if 1 < len(tokens) <= 4:
                return normalize_caps(tokens[0]), normalize_caps(tokens[-1])
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_phone(text):
    match = re.search(r"(\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4})", text)
    return match.group(1).strip() if match else "Unknown"

def extract_gpa(text):
    match = re.search(r"GPA\s*[:=]?\s*(\d\.\d{1,2})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    return match.group(1) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",
        "m.a.": "MA", "mba": "MBA", "associate": "AS"
    }
    for key in degree_map:
        if key in text.lower():
            return degree_map[key]
    return "Unknown"

def extract_major(text):
    major_keywords = [
        "Civil Engineering", "Environmental Engineering", "Construction Engineering",
        "Chemical Engineering", "Mechanical Engineering", "Computer Science",
        "Architecture", "Industrial Engineering", "Structural Engineering"
    ]
    for major in major_keywords:
        if major.lower() in text.lower():
            return major
    return "Unknown"

def extract_university(text):
    for key, normalized in university_normalization.items():
        if key.lower() in text.lower():
            return normalized
    return "Unknown"

def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(May|June|July|August|September|October|November|December|January|February|March|April)\\s+\\d{4}", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

def extract_geographic_alignment(text):
    locations = []
    pattern = re.findall(r"\\b([A-Z][a-z]+,?\\s?[A-Z]{2})\\b", text)
    for loc in pattern:
        clean = loc.strip().replace(",", "")
        if clean not in locations:
            locations.append(clean)
        if len(locations) >= 4:
            break
    return locations

def extract_prior_education(text):
    edu_blocks = re.findall(r"(Associate.+?\\n|Northern Virginia Community College.+?\\n)", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if edu_blocks:
        block = " ".join(edu_blocks)
        prior_degree = extract_degree(block)
        prior_university = extract_university(block)
        prior_date_match = re.search(r"(May|June|August|December)\\s+\\d{4}", block)
        prior_grad_date = prior_date_match.group(0) if prior_date_match else "Unknown"
        return prior_degree, prior_university, prior_grad_date
    return "Unknown", "Unknown", "Unknown"

# === MET ON CAMPUS + REPRESENTATIVE SCORE DETECTION (Locks 50, 101, 162–168) ===

def detect_met_on_campus(text, filename):
    found_score = None
    met_flag = False

    score_match = re.search(r"(?<!\d)([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)(?!\d)", text)
    if score_match:
        try:
            found_score = float(score_match.group(1).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    fname_score = re.search(r"(^|[_-])([1-3](?:\.5|\+)?)([_-])", filename)
    if fname_score and not found_score:
        try:
            found_score = float(fname_score.group(2).replace("+", ""))
            met_flag = True
        except:
            pass

    return ("Yes" if met_flag else "No/Unsure", str(found_score) if found_score else "Unknown")


# === STRUCTURED SECTION SPLITTER (Lock 102) ===

def split_into_sections(text):
    lines = text.splitlines()
    sections = {}
    current_section = None
    buffer = []

    headings = {
        "Education", "Experience", "Work Experience", "Skills", "Technical Skills",
        "Projects", "Certifications", "Objective", "Summary", "Leadership", "Activities"
    }

    for line in lines:
        clean = line.strip().lower()
        if clean == "" or len(clean) < 2:
            continue
        for heading in headings:
            if fuzz.ratio(clean, heading.lower()) > 85:
                if current_section:
                    sections[current_section] = "\n".join(buffer)
                    buffer = []
                current_section = heading
                break
        else:
            buffer.append(line)
    if current_section and buffer:
        sections[current_section] = "\n".join(buffer)
    return sections


# === GPT-4 LLM REPAIR + FINAL CONFIRMATION (Locks 160–161) ===

def repair_with_llm(text, parsed_fields):
    try:
        prompt = f\"\"\"You are a resume parsing assistant. Below is a resume's full text and an initial dictionary of extracted fields. Your task is to correct, normalize, and complete any missing fields.

Resume Text:
{text}

Current Fields:
{json.dumps(parsed_fields, indent=2)}

Respond ONLY with corrected JSON:
\"\"\"
        response = openai.ChatCompletion.create(
            model="gpt-4",
            messages=[
                {"role": "system", "content": "You are a resume parser."},
                {"role": "user", "content": prompt}
            ],
            max_tokens=1000,
            temperature=0.2
        )
        corrected = json.loads(response["choices"][0]["message"]["content"])
        return corrected
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"[GPT Repair Error] {e}")
        return parsed_fields

# === FINAL FIELD COLLATION ===

def extract_all_fields(text, file_path):
    first_name, last_name = extract_name(text)
    email = extract_email(text)
    phone = extract_phone(text)
    gpa = extract_gpa(text)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    major = extract_major(text)
    university = extract_university(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)
    alignment = extract_geographic_alignment(text)
    prior_degree, prior_university, prior_grad = extract_prior_education(text)
    met_flag, rep_score = detect_met_on_campus(text, file_path)
    sections = split_into_sections(text)

    return {
        "Raw Text": text.strip(),
        "First Name": first_name,
        "Last Name": last_name,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major,
        "Latest University": university,
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "GPA": gpa,
        "Email": email,
        "Phone Number": phone,
        "Geographic Alignment": alignment,
        "Met on Campus": met_flag,
        "Representative Score": rep_score,
        "Prior Degree": prior_degree,
        "Prior University": prior_university,
        "Prior Graduation Date": prior_grad,
        "Sections": sections,
        "Source File": os.path.basename(file_path)
    }


# === VALIDATION ===

def validate_fields(data):
    if not re.match(r"[^@]+@[^@]+\\.[^@]+", data.get("Email", "")):
        print("[!] Invalid email format.")
    if not re.match(r"\\d{3}[-.\\s]?\\d{3}[-.\\s]?\\d{4}", data.get("Phone Number", "")):
        print("[!] Invalid phone format.")


# === JSON SAVE ===

def save_parsed_data(data, output_dir=save_directory):
    if not os.path.exists(output_dir):
        os.makedirs(output_dir)
    last = data.get("Last Name", "Unknown")
    first = data.get("First Name", "Unknown")
    degree = data.get("Latest Degree", "Unknown")
    major = data.get("Latest Major", "Unknown")
    university = data.get("Latest University", "Unknown").replace(",", "")
    grad = data.get("Graduation Date", "Unknown")
    filename = f"{last}, {first} - {degree} - {major} - {university} ({grad}).json"
    safe_name = re.sub(r"[^a-zA-Z0-9 \\-\\(\\)\\.]", "", filename)
    path = os.path.join(output_dir, safe_name)
    with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
        json.dump(data, f, indent=4)
    print(f"[✔] Saved to: {path}")


# === POST PROCESSING + OVERRIDE ===

def process_resume(file_path):
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    base = extract_all_fields(text, file_path)
    filename_key = os.path.basename(file_path)
    if filename_key in known_good_fields:
        print("[⚠] Overriding with known_good_fields.json")
        base.update(known_good_fields[filename_key])
    if any(v == "Unknown" for v in base.values()):
        base = repair_with_llm(text, base)
    validate_fields(base)
    save_parsed_data(base)
    shutil.move(file_path, os.path.join(processed_directory, os.path.basename(file_path)))

🔹 V7 BLOCK 6: Watchdog, CLI Entrypoint, Lock Footer
# === WATCHDOG CLASS ===

class ResumeHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_created(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        print(f"[📥] New file detected: {event.src_path}")
        try:
            process_resume(event.src_path)
        except Exception as e:
            print(f"[❌] Failed to process {event.src_path}: {e}")


def start_watching():
    observer = Observer()
    handler = ResumeHandler()
    observer.schedule(handler, monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print(f"[👀] Watching directory: {monitor_directory}")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()


# === BATCH MODE ===

def process_batch_folder(folder):
    print(f"[📦] Batch parsing files in: {folder}")
    for fname in os.listdir(folder):
        full_path = os.path.join(folder, fname)
        if os.path.isfile(full_path) and not fname.lower().endswith(".json"):
            try:
                process_resume(full_path)
            except Exception as e:
                print(f"[❌] Error: {e}")


# === MAIN ENTRYPOINT ===

if __name__ == "__main__":
    import argparse
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--watch", action="store_true", help="Watch folder for new resumes")
    parser.add_argument("--batch", action="store_true", help="Parse all existing resumes in folder")
    args = parser.parse_args()

    if args.watch:
        start_watching()
    elif args.batch:
        process_batch_folder(monitor_directory)
    else:
        print("⚠️  Use --watch or --batch")

# Initialize spaCy

# Directories

# University normalization

    "University of Michigan": "University of Michigan, Ann Arbor",
    "The University of Michigan": "University of Michigan, Ann Arbor",

def extract_text_from_pdf(file_path):
    from pdfminer.high_level import extract_text as extract_pdf_text
    try:
        return extract_pdf_text(file_path)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"PDF extraction error: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_image(file_path):
    text = ""
    try:
        images = convert_from_path(file_path, dpi=300)
        for img in images:
            img = img.convert("L").filter(ImageFilter.SHARPEN)
            text += pytesseract.image_to_string(img)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"OCR error: {e}")
    return text

def is_scanned(file_path):
    try:
        doc = fitz.open(file_path)
        for page in doc:
            if page.get_images(full=True):
                return True
        return False
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Scan detection error: {e}")
        return False

def extract_text_from_file(file_path):
    ext = file_path.lower()
    if ext.endswith(".pdf"):
        return extract_text_from_image(file_path) if is_scanned(file_path) else extract_text_from_pdf(file_path)
    elif ext.endswith(".docx"):
        return extract_text_from_docx(file_path)
    elif ext.endswith(".xlsx"):
        return extract_text_from_excel(file_path)
    elif ext.endswith(".eml"):
        return extract_text_from_eml(file_path)
    elif ext.endswith(".msg"):
        return extract_text_from_msg(file_path)
    elif ext.endswith(".zip"):
        return extract_text_from_zip(file_path)
    else:
        print(f"Unsupported file type: {file_path}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    try:
        doc = docx.Document(file_path)
        return "\n".join(p.text for p in doc.paragraphs)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"DOCX error: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_excel(file_path):
    try:
        wb = openpyxl.load_workbook(file_path)
        sheet = wb.active
        return ' '.join(str(cell) for row in sheet.iter_rows(values_only=True) for cell in row if cell)
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Excel parse error: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_eml(file_path):
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'rb') as f:
            msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
            return ''.join(part.get_payload(decode=True).decode('utf-8', errors='ignore')
                           for part in msg.iter_parts() if part.get_content_type() == 'text/plain')
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"EML parse error: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_msg(file_path):
    try:
        import extract_msg
        msg = extract_msg.Message(file_path)
        return msg.body or ""
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"MSG parse error: {e}")
        return ""

def extract_text_from_zip(file_path):
    temp_dir = "temp_resumes"
    os.makedirs(temp_dir, exist_ok=True)
    text = ""
    try:
        with zipfile.ZipFile(file_path, 'r') as zip_ref:
            zip_ref.extractall(temp_dir)
        for name in os.listdir(temp_dir):
            text += extract_text_from_file(os.path.join(temp_dir, name))
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"ZIP error: {e}")
    finally:
        shutil.rmtree(temp_dir, ignore_errors=True)
    return text

def extract_name(text):
    lines = text.strip().splitlines()
    for line in lines[:3]:
        clean = line.strip()
        if clean and 2 <= len(clean.split()) <= 4:
            tokens = clean.split()
            if all(token[0].isupper() for token in tokens if token.isalpha()):
                return tokens[0], tokens[-1]
    doc = nlp(text)
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            parts = ent.text.strip().split()
            if len(parts) >= 2:
                return parts[0], parts[-1]
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor of science": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master of science": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master": "MS",
        "mba": "MBA", "doctor": "PhD", "phd": "PhD"
    }
    text_lower = text.lower()
    for key in sorted(degree_map.keys(), key=len, reverse=True):
        if re.search(rf"\b{re.escape(key)}\b", text_lower):
            return degree_map[key]
    return "Unknown"

def extract_university(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    for key, normalized in university_normalization.items():
        if key.lower() in text_lower:
            return normalized
    return "Unknown"

def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(Graduation|Expected Graduation)\s*[:\-\s]*(\w+\s+\d{4})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        return match.group(2)
    match = re.search(r"(Bachelor|Master|BS|MS|BA|MA|PhD)[^,:\n]*[,:\-\s]+(\w+\s+\d{4})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        return match.group(2)
    return "Unknown"

def extract_major(text):
    known_majors = [
        "civil engineering", "environmental engineering", "chemical engineering", "mechanical engineering",
        "computer science", "data science", "business administration", "electrical engineering", "biomedical engineering"
    ]
    text_lower = text.lower()
    for major in known_majors:
        if major in text_lower:
            return major.title()
    return "Unknown"

def sanitize_filename(name):
    return re.sub(r'[<>:"/\\|?*]', "_", name)

def extract_data_with_nlp(text, file_path):
    first, last = extract_name(text)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    university = extract_university(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)
    major = extract_major(text)
    return {
        "Raw Text": text.strip(),
        "First Name": first,
        "Last Name": last,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major,
        "Latest University": university,
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "Source File": os.path.basename(file_path)
    }

def apply_known_good_fixes(filename, parsed):
    try:
        with open("known_good_fields.json", "r", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            overrides = json.load(f)
        base = os.path.basename(filename)
        if base in overrides:
            print(f"⚠️ Overriding fields with known-good data for: {base}")
            parsed.update(overrides[base])
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Known-good override load failed: {e}")
    return parsed

class ResumeHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_created(self, event):
        if not event.is_directory:
            print(f"New resume detected: {event.src_path}")
            process_resume(event.src_path)

def process_resume(file_path):
    print(f"Processing: {file_path}")
    text = extract_text_from_file(file_path)
    parsed = extract_data_with_nlp(text, file_path)
    parsed = apply_known_good_fixes(file_path, parsed)
    save_parsed_data_to_json(parsed)

def save_parsed_data_to_json(parsed):
    filename = f"{parsed['Last Name']}, {parsed['First Name']} - {parsed['Latest Degree']} - {parsed['Latest Major']} - {parsed['Latest University']} ({parsed['Graduation Date']}).json"
    path = os.path.join(save_directory, sanitize_filename(filename))
    try:
        with open(path, "w", encoding="utf-8") as f:
            json.dump(parsed, f, indent=4)
        print(f"✅ Saved to: {path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"❌ Error saving JSON: {e}")

def start_monitoring():
    observer = Observer()
    observer.schedule(ResumeHandler(), monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print("📂 Monitoring directory for new resumes... Press Ctrl+C to stop.")
    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

# --- Start the monitoring ---
start_monitoring()

# Function to determine if the resume is scanned
def is_scanned(file_path):
    """
    Determines if the resume is a scanned (image-based) PDF or a text-based (digital) PDF.
    """
    ext = file_path.lower().split('.')[-1]
    if ext == 'pdf':
        doc = fitz.open(file_path)
        for page_num in range(len(doc)):
            page = doc.load_page(page_num)
            if page.get_text("text"):  # Check if text is extracted from the page
                return False  # It's a digital (text-based) resume
    return True  # Treat as scanned if not a text-based PDF

# Function to clean invalid characters from filenames
def sanitize_filename(filename):
    invalid_chars = r'<>:"/\\|?*\n'  # Include \n to remove newlines
    sanitized_filename = re.sub(f'[{invalid_chars}]', '_', filename)
    return sanitized_filename

# Extract degree using refined normalization logic
def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",
        "m.a.": "MA", "ma": "MA", "mba": "MBA"
    }
    for key, normalized_degree in degree_map.items():
        if key in text.lower():
            return normalized_degree
    return "Unknown"

# Extract university using regex and normalize
def extract_university(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    for key, normalized_name in university_normalization.items():
        if key.lower() in text_lower:
            return normalized_name
    return "Unknown"

    first_name, last_name = extract_name(doc)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    university = extract_university(text)
    phone_number = extract_phone_number(text)
    email = extract_email(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)

    # Extract majors and minors
    major_1, major_2, minor_1 = extract_majors(text)

    # Check for handwritten score (if resume is scanned)
    handwriting_score = ""
    handwriting_present = False
    if is_scanned(file_path):
        handwritten_lines = extract_handwritten_text(file_path)
        if handwritten_lines:
            handwriting_present = True
            for line in handwritten_lines:
                score = extract_campus_rep_score_from_handwriting(line)
                if score:
                    handwriting_score = score
                    break

    # Check for score in filename (if any)
    file_score = extract_campus_rep_score_from_filename(file_path)
    campus_rep_score = handwriting_score if handwriting_score else file_score

    if not campus_rep_score:
        campus_rep_score = "Met on Campus, Not Captured"  # For scanned resumes without a detected score

    # Extract font data (predominant font size/type)
    predominant_font_size, predominant_font_family = extract_font_metadata(file_path)

    parsed_data = {
        "First Name": first_name,
        "Last Name": last_name,
        "Phone Number": phone_number,
        "Email": email,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major_1,
        "Major 2": major_2 if major_2 != "Unknown" else None,
        "Minor 1": minor_1 if minor_1 != "Unknown" else None,
        "Latest University": university,
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "Resume": text,
        "Handwriting Present": handwriting_present,
        "Handwriting Score": handwriting_score,
        "Campus Rep Score": campus_rep_score,
        "Predominant Font Size": predominant_font_size,
        "Predominant Font Family": predominant_font_family
    }

    return parsed_data

# Extract degree from resume
def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",

    return "Unknown"

# Function to extract name from the resume text
def extract_name(doc):
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            name_parts = ent.text.split()
            return name_parts[0], name_parts[-1]
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

# Function to extract phone number
def extract_phone_number(text):
    match = re.search(r"\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

# Function to extract email
def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

# Function to extract graduation date
def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(Graduation|Expected Graduation)\s*[:\-\s]*(\w+\s+\d{4})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        return match.group(2)
    return "Unknown"

# Save parsed data to a JSON file
def save_parsed_data_to_json(parsed_data, resume_name):
    filename = f"{parsed_data['Last Name']}, {parsed_data['First Name']} - {parsed_data['Latest Degree']} - {parsed_data['Latest Major']} - {parsed_data['Latest University']} ({parsed_data['Graduation Date']}).json"
    sanitized_filename = sanitize_filename(filename)
    file_path = os.path.join(save_directory, sanitized_filename)
    
    try:
        with open(file_path, 'w') as json_file:
            json.dump(parsed_data, json_file, indent=4)
        print(f"Data saved to: {file_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error saving file {file_path}: {e}")

# Main function to process resumes
def process_resume(file_path):
    print(f"Processing: {file_path}")
    text = ""
    
    if file_path.lower().endswith('.pdf'):
        if is_scanned(file_path):
            text = extract_text_from_image(file_path)  # Process as image-based PDF
        else:
            text = extract_text_from_pdf(file_path)  # Process as text-based PDF
    elif file_path.lower().endswith('.docx'):
        text = extract_text_from_docx(file_path)
    
    parsed_data = extract_data_with_nlp(text, file_path)
    save_parsed_data_to_json(parsed_data, os.path.basename(file_path))

# Extract text from DOCX file
def extract_text_from_docx(file_path):
    doc = docx.Document(file_path)
    text = ""
    for para in doc.paragraphs:
        text += para.text
    return text

# Process ZIP files to extract resumes
def process_zip(zip_file):
    with zipfile.ZipFile(zip_file, 'r') as zip_ref:
        zip_ref.extractall("temp_resumes")
    for file_name in os.listdir("temp_resumes"):
        process_resume(os.path.join("temp_resumes", file_name))

# Process EML and extract resume attachments
def process_eml(eml_file):
    with open(eml_file, 'rb') as f:
        msg = BytesParser(policy=policy.default).parse(f)
        for part in msg.iter_attachments():
            if part.get_content_type() in ['application/pdf', 'application/msword', 'application/vnd.openxmlformats-officedocument.wordprocessingml.document']:
                file_name = part.get_filename()
                with open(file_name, 'wb') as f_out:
                    f_out.write(part.get_payload(decode=True))
                process_resume(file_name)

# Start the monitoring process
class ResumeHandler(FileSystemEventHandler):
    def on_created(self, event):
        if event.is_directory:
            return
        print(f"New resume detected: {event.src_path}")
        process_resume(event.src_path)

# Start monitoring the folder
def start_monitoring():
    event_handler = ResumeHandler()
    observer = Observer()
    observer.schedule(event_handler, monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print("Monitoring directory for new resumes...")

    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()

# Start the monitoring process
start_monitoring()

    "The University of Michigan": "University of Michigan, Ann Arbor",
    "Michigan": "University of Michigan, Ann Arbor",
    "University of California, Berkeley": "University of California, Berkeley",

# Function to determine if the resume is scanned
def is_scanned(file_path):
    """
    Determines if the resume is a scanned (image-based) PDF or a text-based (digital) PDF.
    """
    ext = file_path.lower().split('.')[-1]
    if ext == 'pdf':
        doc = fitz.open(file_path)
        for page_num in range(len(doc)):
            page = doc.load_page(page_num)
            if page.get_text("text"):  # Check if text is extracted from the page
                return False  # It's a digital (text-based) resume
    return True  # Treat as scanned if not a text-based PDF

# Function to clean invalid characters from filenames
def sanitize_filename(filename):
    invalid_chars = r'<>:"/\\|?*\n'  # Include \n to remove newlines
    sanitized_filename = re.sub(f'[{invalid_chars}]', '_', filename)
    return sanitized_filename

# Extract degree using refined normalization logic
def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",
        "m.a.": "MA", "ma": "MA", "mba": "MBA"
    }
    for key, normalized_degree in degree_map.items():
        if key in text.lower():
            return normalized_degree
    return "Unknown"

# Extract university using regex and normalize
def extract_university(text):
    text_lower = text.lower()
    for key, normalized_name in university_normalization.items():
        if key.lower() in text_lower:
            return normalized_name
    return "Unknown"

# Function to extract data with NLP (including university and graduation date)
def extract_data_with_nlp(text, file_path):
    doc = nlp(text)
    first_name, last_name = extract_name(doc)
    degree = extract_degree(text)
    university = extract_university(text)
    phone_number = extract_phone_number(text)
    email = extract_email(text)
    grad_date = extract_graduation_date(text)

    # Extract majors and minors
    major_1, major_2, minor_1 = extract_majors(text)

    # Check for handwritten score (if resume is scanned)
    handwriting_score = ""
    handwriting_present = False
    if is_scanned(file_path):
        handwritten_lines = extract_handwritten_text(file_path)
        if handwritten_lines:
            handwriting_present = True
            for line in handwritten_lines:
                score = extract_campus_rep_score_from_handwriting(line)
                if score:
                    handwriting_score = score
                    break

    # Check for score in filename (if any)
    file_score = extract_campus_rep_score_from_filename(file_path)
    campus_rep_score = handwriting_score if handwriting_score else file_score

    if not campus_rep_score:
        campus_rep_score = "Met on Campus, Not Captured"  # For scanned resumes without a detected score

    # Extract font data (predominant font size/type)
    predominant_font_size, predominant_font_family = extract_font_metadata(file_path)

    parsed_data = {
        "First Name": first_name,
        "Last Name": last_name,
        "Phone Number": phone_number,
        "Email": email,
        "Latest Degree": degree,
        "Latest Major": major_1,
        "Major 2": major_2 if major_2 != "Unknown" else None,
        "Minor 1": minor_1 if minor_1 != "Unknown" else None,
        "Latest University": university,
        "Graduation Date": grad_date,
        "Resume": text,  # Raw resume content is the top line
        "Handwriting Present": handwriting_present,
        "Handwriting Score": handwriting_score,
        "Campus Rep Score": campus_rep_score,
        "Predominant Font Size": predominant_font_size,
        "Predominant Font Family": predominant_font_family
    }

    return parsed_data

# Extract degree from resume
def extract_degree(text):
    degree_map = {
        "bachelor": "BS", "b.s.": "BS", "bachelor of science": "BS", "bachelor of arts": "BA",
        "master": "MS", "m.s.": "MS", "master of science": "MS", "phd": "PhD", "doctor": "PhD",

    }
    for key, normalized_degree in degree_map.items():
        if key in text.lower():
            return normalized_degree
    return "Unknown"

# Function to extract name from the resume text
def extract_name(doc):
    for ent in doc.ents:
        if ent.label_ == "PERSON":
            name_parts = ent.text.split()
            return name_parts[0], name_parts[-1]
    return "Unknown", "Unknown"

# Function to extract phone number
def extract_phone_number(text):
    match = re.search(r"\(?\d{3}\)?[-.\s]?\d{3}[-.\s]?\d{4}", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

# Function to extract email
def extract_email(text):
    match = re.search(r"[\w\.-]+@[\w\.-]+", text)
    return match.group(0) if match else "Unknown"

# Function to extract graduation date
def extract_graduation_date(text):
    match = re.search(r"(Graduation|Expected Graduation)\s*[:\-\s]*(\w+\s+\d{4})", text, re.IGNORECASE)
    if match:
        return match.group(2)
    return "Unknown"

        print(f"Data saved to: {file_path}")
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error saving file {file_path}: {e}")

        if event.is_directory:
            return
        print(f"New resume detected: {event.src_path}")
        process_resume(event.src_path)

# Start monitoring the folder
def start_monitoring():
    event_handler = ResumeHandler()
    observer = Observer()
    observer.schedule(event_handler, monitor_directory, recursive=False)
    observer.start()
    print("Monitoring directory for new resumes...")

    try:
        while True:
            time.sleep(1)
    except KeyboardInterrupt:
        observer.stop()
    observer.join()
